bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to economic development; appropriating money for a grant to the Urban League Twin Cities.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; URBAN LEAGUE TWIN CITIES.

$400,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $400,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the workforce development fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to Urban League Twin Cities for support and expansion of its workforce solutions and wealth building programs. These are onetime appropriations.
additions: $400,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $400,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the workforce development fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to Urban League Twin Cities for support and expansion of its workforce solutions and wealth building programs. These are onetime appropriations.
